fallback module-side-effect tests/fixtures/module-const-cycle/input.tsx:5:14 this module has a declaration the compiler cannot prove runs nothing (only `const`s it folds or proves plain, and functions); the code brust compiles copies the module's declarations but not code that runs when it loads, so a value read from a module binding could differ from React's — keep module scope to imports, functions and constants (move other code into the function that needs it), or keep this component in React
